about: Task 17: power of the calibration bar (same sign in at least 8 of 10 matches and a two-sided permutation p at most 0.00135 over 2000 null draws) for each candidate alive after its probe, simulated on the real design of the calibration matches with the within-possession correlation of the statistic before t ([t - W, t]). Effects in sd of the noise. No outcome of any candidate is computed. Definitions in the docstrings of ac2fb.defence.power and ac2fb.defence.bar.

cp1_rule.rule: C2 first if it survived probe S2 and its V1 MDE80 is at most mde_limit; otherwise C1 if alive; C3 only as a backup; none alive, branch B. CP1 decides, also which contrast C3 would use.
